name: Tool fleet returns
prompts: We lease cordless tools to building sites. Repairs over $600 go to the fleet manager. Never issue a grade C or D tool without refurbishment.
Our power tools come back at the end of a fleet contract. Refurbish a tool when a named contract or buyer order can take it, otherwise sell it to a trade buyer.
Returned tools that cannot be repaired economically are harvested for parts on open repair orders, or recycled through a certified recycler.

clarify.question: When a repair is over your limit, who signs it off?

options.label: The tool pool planner decides alone
options.adds: Keeps the pack's approval rule as it is.

guardrails.text: Grade C and D tools are never issued to a fleet without refurbishment
Refurbishment always ends in a named fleet contract, sales order or pool request
Harvested parts are certified only at or above the fit-for-use threshold
The holding cost rate is set by Finance
Every decision is approved by a named owner before execution
Recycling only through a certified recycler, certificate and CO2 record on file
